## Purpose

Addresses the diagnostics slice of #64938. With PCP disabled, an explicit DCP that does not divide TP currently fails with only the divisibility error. Include the topology-compatible DCP values and a reminder that model/backend constraints may further restrict them. For example, TP=4/DCP=3 now reports `[1, 2, 4]`.

The validation condition, accepted configurations and exception type remain unchanged. The divisor list is computed only on the existing error path. No automatic selection, fallback, default, PCP/GQA policy, rank grouping or serving logic changes. The broader auto/fallback requests in #64938 remain out of scope.

Updated the context-parallel deployment guide. Reused `tests/test_config.py`, which Engine Core CI selects for config changes.

## Duplicate-work check

Checked the issue comments, timeline and open PR searches for `64938` and the DCP/config area before claiming and again before this PR. No PR was found for this divisibility diagnostic. #47041, #46207, #48665 and #52075 address worker/backend compatibility messages; those paths are untouched. #55030 concerns the separate PCP/GQA validation policy, also untouched.

## Test plan and results

On the unmodified base `3a90cc6f`, the three new constructor diagnostic cases fail because the remedy text is absent; the three explicit-topology controls pass. The new real `LLM(...)` entry-point test also fails its diagnostic assertion with the original `tp_size=1 must be divisible by dcp_size=8` message. After the fix all seven new cases pass.

Commands (from the checkout, in an isolated uv Python 3.12 environment):

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/private/tmp/vllm64938-cache \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_config.py \
  -k 'invalid_dcp_reports_topology_compatible_values or dcp_diagnostics_preserve_explicit_topology or llm_invalid_dcp_reports_topology_remedy' -q
# Base: 3 constructor diagnostic failures + 1 LLM diagnostic assertion failure;
#       3 topology controls pass (constructor and entry-point commands run separately).
# Patched: 7 passed.

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/private/tmp/vllm64938-cache \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_config.py \
  -k 'invalid_dcp_reports_topology_compatible_values or dcp_diagnostics_preserve_explicit_topology or llm_invalid_dcp_reports_topology_remedy or test_data_parallel_rpc_port or test_eplb_num_redundant_experts_default' -q
# Final rerun: 15 passed, 496 deselected in 1.37s.

.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files \
  vllm/config/parallel.py tests/test_config.py \
  docs/serving/context_parallel_deployment.md
# All applicable hooks passed, including mypy and test tethering.
git diff --check
# Passed.
```

The `LLM` test uses a local minimal OPT config, reaches real configuration validation and fails before loading weights. No model download, GPU, distributed inference, generation, full test suite or benchmark was run. A source-checkout `vllm._version` warning was present. No model-output or performance claim is made; model evaluations are not applicable to this diagnostic-only change.

## AI assistance

Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. The human submitter reviewed the changed lines and the explanation of unchanged parallel policy, then explicitly requested the final test rerun and PR preparation. The test commands above were executed by Codex on the submitter's machine. The commit includes AI attribution and DCO signoff.

detail.title: [Bugfix] Show topology-compatible DCP values in configuration errors

files.patch:
@@ -51,6 +51,18 @@ In short, for decode context parallel, try to increase `-tp` size until you get
 
 Decode context parallel is supported in vLLM, for both MLA and GQA models. Some attention backends also support the combination of decode context parallel and MTP (multi-token prediction) to further accelerate the decoding phase.
 
+### Invalid DCP configuration
+
+`--decode-context-parallel-size` defaults to `1`. When prefill context
+parallelism is disabled (`--prefill-context-parallel-size 1`), DCP must divide
+`--tensor-parallel-size`. An invalid explicit value fails at configuration
+validation; vLLM does not automatically choose a replacement or fall back.
+
+For example, TP=4 and DCP=3 fails with topology-compatible DCP values
+`[1, 2, 4]` in the error message. These values satisfy the TP divisibility
+constraint only: model and attention backend constraints may further restrict
+them. Choose an explicit value compatible with all constraints and restart.
+
 ## Technical Discussions
 
 The main discussions happen in the `#sig-context-parallel` channel of [vLLM Slack](https://slack.vllm.ai/).

@@ -4631,3 +4631,58 @@ def test_hybrid_layer_counts_sparse_attention_as_attention(
             )
             == len(layer_types) - expected_attention
         )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tp,dcp,values",
+    [(1, 8, "[1]"), (4, 3, "[1, 2, 4]"), (6, 4, "[1, 2, 3, 6]")],
+)
+def test_invalid_dcp_reports_topology_compatible_values(tp, dcp, values):
+    """Invalid DCP must fail with a remedy, without silently changing topology."""
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc:
+        ParallelConfig(tensor_parallel_size=tp, decode_context_parallel_size=dcp)
+    message = str(exc.value)
+    assert f"tp_size={tp} must be divisible by dcp_size={dcp}" in message
+    assert (
+        f"topology-compatible --decode-context-parallel-size values are {values}"
+        in message
+    )
+    assert "Model and attention backend constraints may further restrict" in message
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dcp", [1, 2, 4])
+def test_dcp_diagnostics_preserve_explicit_topology(dcp):
+    config = ParallelConfig(tensor_parallel_size=4, decode_context_parallel_size=dcp)
+    assert config.tensor_parallel_size == 4
+    assert config.prefill_context_parallel_size == 1
+    assert config.decode_context_parallel_size == dcp
+
+
+def test_llm_invalid_dcp_reports_topology_remedy(tmp_path):
+    """Reject invalid topology at the public entry point before loading weights."""
+    from vllm import LLM
+
+    (tmp_path / "config.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "model_type": "opt",
+                "architectures": ["OPTForCausalLM"],
+                "hidden_size": 64,
+                "num_attention_heads": 4,
+                "ffn_dim": 128,
+                "num_hidden_layers": 2,
+                "max_position_embeddings": 512,
+                "vocab_size": 100,
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(
+        ValidationError,
+        match=(r"topology-compatible --decode-context-parallel-size values are \[1\]"),
+    ):
+        LLM(
+            model=str(tmp_path),
+            skip_tokenizer_init=True,
+            tensor_parallel_size=1,
+            decode_context_parallel_size=8,
+        )

@@ -637,7 +637,14 @@ def _validate_parallel_config(self) -> Self:
         if pcp == 1:
             # DCP reuses the TP ranks when PCP is disabled.
             if tp % dcp != 0:
-                raise ValueError(f"tp_size={tp} must be divisible by dcp_size={dcp}.")
+                valid_dcp_sizes = [size for size in range(1, tp + 1) if tp % size == 0]
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"tp_size={tp} must be divisible by dcp_size={dcp}. "
+                    f"For TP={tp}, PCP={pcp}, topology-compatible "
+                    "--decode-context-parallel-size values are "
+                    f"{valid_dcp_sizes}. Model and attention backend "
+                    "constraints may further restrict these values."
+                )
         elif dcp not in (1, pcp, tp * pcp):
             raise ValueError(
                 "When PCP is enabled, DCP must be disabled, span the PCP "
